t: You're looking at 45 to 51 Monmouth Street and 29 to 31 Mercer Street, in the Seven Dials area of Camden. The buildings were designed by Terry Farrell, the British architect and urban designer who lived from 1938 to 2025. I don't have much more detail on these particular buildings, but they sit in the same part of Covent Garden as his regeneration of the nearby triangular block around Ching Court.
